comment: Development seed only: weakness-level advisories for the HTTP findings the scanner produces. No CVE applies to these generic misconfigurations, so cve_id/cvss stay null. Mappings follow long-standing scanner-community practice (ZAP rule taxonomy) and OWASP guidance; nothing here is invented scan data.

entries.remediation: Serve a Strict-Transport-Security header with a long max-age and includeSubDomains, after verifying full HTTPS coverage.
Deploy a Content-Security-Policy starting in report-only mode, then enforce a least-privilege policy.
Send X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN where framing is required) or an equivalent frame-ancestors CSP directive.

entries.affected_technology: Web applications using cookies over HTTPS
entries.remediation: Mark sensitive cookies Secure (and HttpOnly unless JavaScript access is required).
